DETAILS6: Absolute pitch barely transfers to playing. The skills that do are functional: hearing a note as a scale degree inside a key, hearing a chord's quality, and hearing where a progression is going. Chapters C and D are the ones that show up when you improvise.
rather than "a fourth above something", you can find a melody by ear in real time.
<li data-i18n="about.li.1">Sing the answer before you click it. Passive listening plateaus fast.
<li data-i18n="about.li.2">Do the chord chapters with arpeggio off. Block chords force you to hear the whole stack, not the top line.
<li data-i18n="about.li.3">Jam tab is the transfer test: loop a progression, improvise, and check yourself against the highlighted chord tones.
<li data-i18n="about.li.4">Ten focused minutes daily beats an hour once a week.
FOOTER7: <footer data-i18n="footer">One file, no network. Save it and it runs offline. Progress lives in this browser's storage.
